result:
Comments, reporting and auto-hiding are in. `bun run typecheck` passes and `bun test` passes (5 tests, including a new one for comments). I didn't boot the app or check anything over HTTP.

- **Storage:** `db/schema.ts` gains `comments` and `comment_reports`. `comment_reports` has a unique index on (`comment_id`, `user_id`). Migration `20261018124148_add_comments` is generated.
- **Endpoints:**
  - `POST /posts/:id/comments` requires login and takes a 1–2000 character `body`. A bad body gets a 422 and stores nothing; success redirects to `/posts/:id`.
  - `DELETE /comments/:id` works for the comment's author or the post's author and redirects to the post. Anyone else gets 403.
  - `POST /comments/:id/report` always answers 204 and a repeat report adds no second row.
  - Guests are redirected to `/login` on all three.
- **Post page:** the `posts/Show` props now include `comments` as `{ id, body, author: { id, name }, createdAt }`, oldest first. A comment with three or more distinct reporters is left out of the list but stays in the table.
- **Post deletion:** deleting a post also deletes its comments and their reports.
- **UI:** `Show.tsx` lists the comments, has a comment box for signed-in users, and shows Delete where the viewer may use it and Report for any signed-in user. Guests see a "Log in to comment" link.
- **Where the code is:** the new code is in `CommentController`, the `Comment` and `CommentReport` models and `CommentValidator`. `PostController` and `routes/web.ts` are edited.

I did the cascade in `PostController.destroy` as well as with `ON DELETE CASCADE` in the schema. I didn't confirm that SQLite foreign keys are enforced in this app, so the explicit delete is the safeguard.

The new test is `tests/CommentController.test.ts`. It covers the guest redirect, the 422, 403 for a third user, the 204 on repeat reports, hiding after three reporters, deletion by the post's author, and comments going when the post is deleted. It doesn't check the oldest-first order or the author and `createdAt` fields.
